item: The check from format's record leaves out the notes format and a full check print
notes: Trial 68 (sendgrid-csharp, Avro, Bedrock): the verdict and exit code of a check answered from format's record equal those of a full check (record deleted), but its output lacks the informational lines the full check prints: 'Leaving alone: ... StyleCop didn't run there', 'Old CodeStyle package: ...' (#329), 'Configurations: ...', 'Without StyleBro: ...' and the workspace-warnings note. In CI there is no record, so a fresh clone prints them; after a local format they were printed by format. To decide: keep the notes in the record and say them again, or leave it.
